profile.headline: Web Developer in Indianapolis, IN
profile.summary: I have been working as a professional web developer/programmer around Indianapolis, IN for over 15 years.  Along with working for various commercial web development firms, I have worked in Education, Government, Insurance, Marketing, and Consulting.  I specialize in Application Development and working with Content Management Systems.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Provided comprehensive support for DMC Insurance's WordPress-based website, ensuring optimal performance and user experience.  
• Installed and updated plugins, while offering technical assistance to employees to enhance website functionality.  
• Customized site features by modifying CSS, JS, and PHP code, contributing to ADA compliance and WCAG 2.1 standards.  
• Maintained and improved various insurance-related internal web applications using PHP and SQL Server Azure.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of a team of multiple developers, I supported the Navion Healthcare Solutions application.  The application collects, calculates, and formats health care data and submits it to national registries.  It was written in a combination of ASP.net/JavaScript/React.js. 

I wrote complex SQL Statements/Stored Procedures to validate data in the system.  The Stored Procedures are used to collect, aggregate, and format data that is both imported from and exported to registries that track health data nation-wide.

I wrote documentation for the system for other developers to use.

I participate in daily standups and various scrum activities.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Developed CountryMark Dealer portal.  The portal allowed various CountryMark dealers to receive news, product information, and gasoline prices.  This portal was written in ASP.net/C# and used the Sitefinity CMS.

Developed Seven Corners Group Travel website.  This website allowed a user to create a group travel policy for their trip.  This website was written in ASP.net/C# and used the Sitefinity CMS.

Created First American Home Warranty website.  This website provided consumer information about their home warranty policy with First American Home Warranty.  The website was written in C# and retrieved data from the CrownPeak CMS.

Converted various Eli Lilly product websites from the CrownPeak CMS into a Heuroku Node.js website.  During this conversion, the websites were being redesigned.  The websites were written in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  I also performed Quality Assurance tasks while migrating the websites.

Website Support and Development for Elanco Animal Health.  I performed a wide variety of tasks during an extended engagement at Elanco Animal Health.  I created/maintained/enhanced various product websites in the CrownPeak CMS.  This was done using a combination of ASP.NET, C#, and HTML5.  I also trouble shot and fixed issues (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with in the websites.  I also helped improve SEO on the product sites and install various SEO tools.  I performed Quality Assurance inspection of vendor’s work before deployment.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As part of a team of multiple developers, I help to create the HealthPlus website.  This website provided information about HealthPlus.  It also provided plan information and information for Members and Employers.  It was written in a combination of ASP.net, C#, and Ektron.

Developed American Association of Endodontists website.  This website allowed members of AAE to login and manage their account and participate in the online community.  It was written in a combination of ASP.net, C#, and Ektron.

I provided support to various customer sites.  These web sites were written in a combination of Ektron, Classic ASP, ASP.net, VB.Net / C#, and the data was stored in a MS SQL Server 2008 database.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I supported and enhanced public/internal web sites for various high-profile clients, including Firestone, Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Kiwanis, NCAA, and the National Federation of High School Associations.  The web sites were written in a combination of ASP.Net, VB.Net / C#, and the data was stored in a MS SQL Server 2008 database.

positions.title: New Media Programmer
positions.description:
Developed Project Brief Application.  This application tracked all graphic and marketing projects at Just Marketing International.   The application was written in ASP.net and C# and the data was stored in a SQL Server 2005 database.

As part of a team of multiple developers, I supported and enhanced public/internal web sites for various high-profile clients, including Apex-Brasil, Crown Royal, and LG.  The web sites were written in a combination of ASP.net, VB.net/C#, and the data was stored in a MS SQL Server 2008 database.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Developed Project/Problem Tracking Report Application.  This application tracked all Information Technology projects and problems for the company.  The application was written in ASP.net and VB.net and the data was stored in a SQL Server 2005 database.

Maintained and enhanced various insurance related web applications on the company's internal intranet site and public web site.  These web applications were written in ASP.net and VB.net and the data was stored in a SQL Sever 2005 database.

Provided technical support on various insurance related server products.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Transferred over 10 City-County wide department web sites into Microsoft Content Management Server 2001.  I also created 6 different MCMS 2001 web sites for various City-County initiatives.  This involved analysis of the website structure, content migration, QA support, customization and implementation, transferring webpage layouts into MCMS 2001 templates, and occasionally designing the web site.  The CMS templates were written in HTML and Classic ASP.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As part of a team of 3 developers, we created a Content Management Application.  We used this application to maintain the department website.  The application provided information about the program, information about the University, course information, and instructor and staff biographies.  The application was written in ASP.net along with C# and the data was stored in a SQL Server 2000 database.

Created and maintained online learning materials for over 10 different instructors.  The materials were written in a combination of Classic ASP, ASP.net, and HTML.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Created and maintained over 25 websites and web applications from various accounts.  I supplied technical support to 6 staff members.

volunteerExperiences.description: I provided assistance in taking care of the cats and dogs at the East Washington Store.

Public-facing Website upgrade and re-design using Ektron CMS.
Completely new responsive website construct, creatively designed by Sandstorm Design and implemented by F648 into Ektron. F648 further upgraded their Ektron implementation and helped consult and train personnel on content authorship and CMS managment.

projects.description:

Completely new responsive website construct creatively designed by Sandstorm Design and implemented by F648. Project strategy managed by .OrgSource
